revision_reason: The selected historical Gin child predates a copyright-line update in the root MIT license; pin the observed child license hash before generating prompts.
purpose: Fixed blind inferability audit of structural Git candidates; not training or quality evidence
selection_rule: Up to three examples per repository, at most one per commit/path/substitution when possible; include an apparent string-literal false positive and the only Go code-identifier example
blind_protocol: Show filetype, 15 lines each side of target, target row, and one synthetic prior one-line edit. Hide child line, substitution summary, and result file. Reviewer may abstain. Ask for exact target line and whether evidence justifies the edit, independently of syntax plausibility.
source_constraints: MIT repository licenses are pinned in the source plan; verify historical child license and per-file notices before any training decision.
acceptance_policy: This audit does not accept a training label. Real editor ordering, user intent, and group-disjoint objective checks remain absent.
